public_body: Weston Housing Production Plan Steering Committee (Hppsc)
overall: Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and timely approve certain minutes, but did not violate it by missing notice or failing to post minutes to the website.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to post notice of its July and August 2015 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee complied with the Law by posting notice of these meetings at least 48 hours in advance of each meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to document attendance, subjects, and votes by creating minutes for several 2015 meetings; two July/August minutes were not drafted until after the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create minutes from its July 2, 2015 and August 13, 2015 meetings in a timely manner.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged minutes from several meetings were not timely approved; some were approved months later and June 18 and August 13 minutes remained unapproved.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Committee also violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely approve minutes from these Committee meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee failed to post minutes and agendas for its meetings to the Town website.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to post its minutes, whether in draft or final form, to the Town website.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Approve the June 18, 2015 and August 13, 2015 meeting minutes within thirty (30) days of receipt of the letter, by the Committee or its parent body.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 2 10 2016 - OML 2016-17 - WESTON HOUSING PRODUCTION PLAN STEERING COMMITTEE (HPPSC).pdf
